:::{#exm-surprisal-rarity-four}
#### Surprisal and rarity of a value with probability one quarter

Take a [value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization) with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1/4$:

```{r}
#| label: surprisal-rarity-four
p_four <- 1 / 4
rarity_four <- 1 / p_four
surprisal_four <- log2(rarity_four)
surprisal_four
```

It has [rarity](#def-rarity) $`r rarity_four`$ by definition.
By @thm-surprisal-log-rarity, its [surprisal](#def-surprisal) is the base-2 [logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm) of that rarity, $`r surprisal_four`$ [bits](#def-bit).
